drivingQuestion: Why is the get invalid even with the second signature ratified?
outcomeNote: The answer to מאי טעמא falls in the next unit

segments.he: ״בְּפָנַי נִכְתַּב כּוּלּוֹ וּבְפָנַי נֶחְתַּם חֶצְיוֹ״, פָּסוּל. אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: וַאֲפִילּוּ שְׁנַיִם מְעִידִים עַל חֲתִימַת יַד שֵׁנִי – פָּסוּל. מַאי טַעְמָא?
segments.en: § The mishna taught that if he said: «All of it was written in my presence and half of it was signed in my presence,» i.e., the agent observed the signing of only one of the witnesses, it is «invalid. Rav Ḥisda says: And even» if «two» people «testify to the signature» of the «second» witness, and the court ratifies this signature, nevertheless it is «invalid. What is the reason» for this ruling? After all, the court has the agent’s testimony with regard to one signature and the confirmation of two witnesses for the second signature.
